newsitem.title: USA: Plains Resources sets 1997 capital plan.
newsitem.headline: Plains Resources sets 1997 capital plan.

text.p: Plains Resources said Thursday its board of directors approved a $67 million capital plan for 1997.
The plan, which excludes costs for any acquisitions, represents an increase of about 24 percent over 1996's capital expenditures.

The company said it will spend about $48 million on the exploitation and development of its LA Basin, Sunniland Trend and Illinois Basin properties. About $14 million will be spent on exploration and higher risk exploitation activities, primarily in South Florida and California.

"Our strong 1996 results reflect the notable impact of last year's capital program and we are optimistic about our slate of capital projects for 1997," said Phil Kramer, Plains' vice president and chief financial officer.
